description: The daily aipozi read for all of the person's sites, or one: for each site, how many of today's answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity named it (and gave its address) and the change since yesterday, per AI; the questions it was named for today and by which AI; the questions lost since yesterday; new rivals (name, age, DR, what they do, which questions they took); the site's DR; what changed since a move was shipped; and today's best move. Stamped with the check time. Use it first for "how am I doing", "read me my aipozi briefing", or a scheduled morning briefing (for example a task every weekday at 07:00: "run daily_briefing from aipozi"). Checks run every morning at 05:00 GMT; this tool never runs one.

site.description: Which of your sites: its domain ("biotree.bio"), its id from list_my_sites ("biotree-bio") or its name. Leave it out when the person has one site.

name: briefing

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the person.

answers.description: Answers in the check (questions x 4 AIs).

bestMove.description: Today's best move: { id, rank, title, kind }, or null.

delta.description: Named, change since the day before; null without a day before.

engines.description: Per AI, one tick per question: 2 named with address, 1 named, 0 not named.

freshness.description: { state, stamp, line }: when the data is from and when the next check runs.

lost.description: Questions named yesterday and not today: { promptId, question, ais }.

market.description: Where its questions are asked from, or null for worldwide.

namedFor.description: Questions named for today: { promptId, question, ais }.

newRivals.description: Young rivals: { domain, name, ageDays, dr, whatTheyDo, engines, questions, locked }.

perEngine.description: Per AI: { ai, label, named, linked, answers }.

plan.description: owner, pro (paid, $29 a month) or free.

sinceShipped.description: Moves marked done and what changed since: { moveId, title, day, url, delta, line }.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" for a question back, a plain no, or nothing there yet (see message).

title: Today's briefing
